title: Exotic Crunchy Saudi Arabian Toor Dal Dal
description: A romantic and crunchy Saudi Arabian dish featuring toor dal, this recipe combines the creaminess of jammy toor dal with the crunch of air-fried onions and spices, perfect for a satvik-friendly meal.
instructions: Rinse the toor dal and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain and cook the toor dal in 2 cups of water until it is soft and mushy.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a pan and saute the grated ginger and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the cumin seeds, coriander powder, and turmeric powder to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked toor dal to the pan and stir well to combine with the spices.
Air-fry the thinly sliced onion until crispy and golden brown.
Add the air-fried onion to the toor dal mixture and stir well to combine.
Serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro.
Cook the toor dal mixture over low heat for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
